ValidationRule.description: SCC-3380: Stops a Case from being its own parent, and stops a two-level circular parent/child relationship.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT(ISBLANK(ParentId)), OR( AND(NOT(ISNEW()), ParentId = Id), AND(NOT(ISBLANK(Parent.ParentId)), Parent.ParentId = Id) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: A case cannot be the parent of itself, and two cases cannot be parents of each other.
